measured_scope: Separate controller demand, restricted command, estimated drive effort and independently instrumented mechanical torque/pressure/force. Trials, simulation and title-only leads are distinguished individually. Bibliographic screening is a reading lead, not a measurement finding.
graph_search: Ranked additional identifiers by the count of deposited reference DOI matches in screened works. Retrieved up to 48 nearest works, retained after scope/metadata screening. Also searched DAMADICS by benchmark name and added verified companion publications from this batch’s dataset investigations. Each CSV edge is an explicit deposited reference DOI or formal full-text reference, with original citing and cited directions. Repository-to-article and dataset references have separately typed relations.

dedup: Parent evidence tree read by pinned Git object ID, including nested tar members and decompressed gzip catalogues; early title and identifier index scanned too. Exact DOI/arXiv/alias and normalized title membership are checked conservatively anywhere in that evidence. For unmatched entries, surname plus token Jaccard above .66 and string similarity above .79 are reviewed. Distinct papers can reuse the same apparatus or measurements.
family_handling: The Japanese experimental paper on ultrasonic series-elastic actuation and its English translation are represented once under the English record, with figure evidence from the Japanese original.

The Dhaouadi 2008 registration variants are grouped. Kircanski’s conference chapter has an extra coauthor and the same title as the later journal study; it is recorded as a family alias to avoid claiming independent experiments.

Saric’s conference and journal reports of sensor-fused clamp force are grouped. The SSRN preprint for the IMM-EKF brake paper and the Research Square spool-valve and piezoelectric preprints are folded into their registered journal records.
The 1991 conference and 1992 journal optimization studies of robot inertia excitation share title and authors and are grouped under the journal identifier.

Gautier/Janot stiffness papers, DAMADICS classifier studies, the two valve compensation parts and related brake-clamp papers retain their own publication identifiers. Overlapping equipment, model or data means publication counts are not counts of independent experiments.
The Park et al. journal paper carries a January 2027 issue date in Crossref. Its DOI was registered on 2026-11-21 and the earlier SSRN preprint already carried the same title and authors.
Three proceedings entries lacking a Crossref issue year use the named 1991 ICRA, ROBOT-97 and 2001 ICRA events. Bibliographic screening alone does not establish their experimental design.
